primary_model: EfficientNet-B0 Deeper P2 (CE plus crop/disease SupCon)
P3_status: separate factorised prototype inference ablation; NOT the P2 classifier
parent_historical_selection: exploratory HM-selected checkpoint on original development unseen split; disclose
image_train_transform: original 224 RandomResizedCrop(scale=.85-1.0), flip, rotation10, ColorJitter; two augmented views
checkpoint_selection_rule: always epoch 3; no validation or test-based selection
inference_preprocessing: BILINEAR Resize short side to 366 + CenterCrop(320) + ImageNet normalization
official_test_policy: evaluate P2 and P3 after fixed checkpoint and prototype verification; compare same official labels and candidate policy
known_limitation: P3 factorised prototypes contain no learned crop-disease compatibility interaction
